bifrost: bifrost_app::view, bifrost_app::widgets, bifrost_ui (stack, constraint, sheet, panels, gesture, ax), render/appearance
summary: Layout, appearance, animation, gestures, drag and drop are covered. Controls, window/screen API, dock tiles and accessibility are partial; app-facing sound, speech and haptics are missing.

features.apple: NSView, NSControl, NSButton, NSTextField, NSSlider, NSTableView, NSCollectionView, NSOutlineView
features.note: Core controls, table and collection models exist; many AppKit controls and bezel styles are missing (see docs/bifrost-ui.md).

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/split.rs (SplitView, place_popover, visible_rows); springboard/ui/src/nav.rs (NavigationStack, NavigationPath); springboard/sdk/src/view/scroll.rs (ScrollPhysics, Fling, rubber band; headless_model_tests); springboard/render/src/glass.rs; springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs
features.note: Split divider limits and collapse, popover placement with edge flipping, visible rows, navigation stacks and paths, and scroll physics have headless tests (the_divider_respects_both_minimum_widths, a_popover_flips_to_the_opposite_edge_when_the_preferred_side_has_no_room, pushing_and_popping_screens_tracks_the_titles_and_the_back_title, a_navigation_path_rebuilds_the_stack_from_its_destinations, a_fast_release_inside_the_range_flings). No view-controller lifecycle clone.
Stack views and a Cassowary constraint solver cover the main layout features.

features.apple: NSAppearance, Dark Mode, accent colour, NSColor named colours
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/appearance.rs; springboard/render/src/ui.rs; wired: springboard/render/src/ui.rs (CONTENT_BG) applied in springboard/apps/{assistant,console,daw,games,music,podcasts,shortcuts,voicememos,weather}-desktop/src; wired: springboard/render/src/ui.rs CONTENT_BG applied in springboard/src/shell/settings.rs (detail pane) and springboard/src/shell/store/mod.rs (store main area)
features.note: Light, Dark and Auto with cross-fade, named adaptive colours; external apps follow it via portal. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 4 (0.5.41); verify on Midget for parity.
Implicit animation with curves and springs; window animation behaviours implemented.

features.apple: NSWindow, NSPanel, NSScreen, sheets, open/save panels, font and colour panels
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/sheet.rs; springboard/ui/src/panels.rs; springboard/src/shell/docpanel.rs; springboard/src/shell/desk.rs; springboard/wm; wired: springboard/src/shell/desk.rs (desk_tile_front, desk_restore_front, edge snap on title-bar drop); springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-11.rs; springboard/src/shell/services/screens.rs (visible frame follows Dock edge and auto-hide)
features.note: Sheet buttons, keys and hit tests, alert sizes, font and colour panel selection and callbacks are tested headless in parity_sdk-tests-11.rs. Gap: the NSScreen-style multi-screen API for apps is thin, and the desk window wiring has no test; verify on Midget for parity. 2026-10-23 follow-up: one work area now drives filled windows and the screens service for Bottom, Left and Right Dock positions, and auto-hide frees the reserved area. 0.10.23 passed host coverage and Midget edge/hover checks; a filled Settings input-path work-area defect was found on Midget and corrected in 0.10.24 with a real event-path regression. 0.10.24 accepted on Midget: filled Settings Left/Right/Bottom work areas and auto-hide were verified through window-local input; hover surfaces were inspected in Light/Dark. Multi-display remains a gap and the row stays partial.

Named system sounds (init(named:) for the alert names) resolve through SystemSounds::named to synthesised tones, not the original recordings; speech and haptics are still missing. Needs a Midget check for parity.
Needs iPhone and Apple Continuity; local camera support exists in the shell.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/responder.rs; springboard/ui/src/keys.rs; springboard/ui/src/focus.rs; springboard/src/shell/textinput.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/hwkeys.rs (Shortcut::Tile on Ctrl+Cmd arrows, Shortcut::CycleWindow on Cmd+`)
features.note: Responder chain, shortcuts and focus exist; event monitors and full text-input client are partial. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 3 (0.5.39); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/menu.rs (Menu, MenuItem, popup_origin); springboard/sdk/src/status_item.rs (StatusItem messages); springboard/src/shell/desktop_bar.rs; springboard/src/shell/desktop_dock.rs; springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs; wired: springboard/src/shell/desktop_bar.rs (Window menu tile, restore and Next Window rows)
features.note: Menu navigation with arrow keys, type-to-select, pop-up checks and row hit testing, and menu-bar extra updates, have headless tests (arrow_keys_skip_separators_and_disabled_rows_and_wrap, typing_selects_the_next_row_whose_title_starts_with_the_typed_text, a_status_item_sends_its_whole_state_on_every_change). Dock tile badges and menus for apps and custom cursors are limited. Verify on Midget for parity.
Gesture recognizers model plus shell trackpad gestures.
Touch Bar hardware is Apple-only; no counterpart planned.
DnD and pasteboard APIs for apps.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/ax.rs (slug, Map, Resolve, Announcements); springboard/src/shell/atspi; springboard/src/shell/accessibility; springboard/src/shell/magnifier.rs; springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01d.rs
features.note: The element map (addresses, resolution by path or name, custom actions) and the announcement queue (politeness, repeats dropped, capacity) have headless tests (a_repeated_name_under_one_parent_gets_a_numbered_address, an_agent_query_resolves_by_address_by_path_or_by_name, assertive_announcements_are_spoken_first_and_repeats_are_dropped). The accessibility tree is bridged over AT-SPI with text and announcements; no full role or rotor coverage.

gaps: App-facing speech synthesis and haptics API (sdk system_sound SystemSounds::named gives synthesised system tones)
App dock tile badges/menus and custom cursors
Missing control types and bezel styles
